title: ChatGPT Needs SPADE (Sustainability, PrivAcy, Digital divide, and Ethics) Evaluation: A Review.
findings: The paper found that early versions of ChatGPT could be prompted to generate biased and harmful content against religious groups (specifically Muslims, through direct mention or via national proxies), such as identifying which houses of worship to place under surveillance. It also notes that OpenAI's review process includes guidelines to avoid generating Islamophobic content, indicating an awareness and mitigation effort for this type of ethical issue.
